kiosk.title: Screen and kiosk
kiosk.intro: For an assistant on a screen: full screen, keeping the screen on, and installing it as an app. You can also say “go full screen” or “keep the screen on”.
kiosk.who: The screen does these itself, so they work where Emkay or another screen that knows them is running.
kiosk.unsupported: This browser can't go full screen or install apps.
kiosk.tap: Tap the big button on the screen to finish.
kiosk.ios: On an iPhone or iPad: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
kiosk.sent: Sent to the screen. If it shows a big button, tap it.
